component.name: Leaf Notes
component.summary: Notes with pen, maths, recordings and flashcards

description.p: A notetaking app for students: write with a pen or type, mix in maths, pictures, PDF printouts and recordings, and study from flashcards. Everything works offline; AI with your own key and sync are optional.

ul.li: Notebooks, sections and pages, with links between pages, tags, tasks and search
Pen and handwriting, turned into text or maths offline
LaTeX maths, tables, checklists and code
Recordings linked to what you wrote, and transcripts
Sync through Google Drive, a synced folder or WebDAV; password-locked sections

screenshot.caption: A lecture page with notes, maths and handwriting

description.p: The paper fills the whole page, and panning stops at its edge.
More room on the page, one clear set of pens, recordings that can always be removed, and Android fixes for rotation, dark mode and typing.
Welcome tour, page history, locked sections, search in handwriting and PDFs, transcripts and more.
